description: This file implements process management functions for reading process info from /proc, matching process names, and building a process map, specifically for PID and command line analysis within a Linux environment.

classes.name: pidmap::proc_t
classes.description: Structure representing a process with command line and PID.

methods.name: is_number
methods.description: Checks if a string consists solely of digits.

methods.name: trim
methods.description: Removes trailing whitespace from a string.

methods.name: readFromFile
methods.description: Reads process info from /proc/[pid]/stat and /proc/[pid]/cmdline, updates process map.

methods.name: compare
methods.description: Compares process command line with a given name, supporting wildcards.

methods.name: pidmap::findChild
methods.description: Recursively finds a child process by name under a parent PID.

methods.name: pidmap::findProcess
methods.description: Finds a process by PID and name.

methods.name: pidmap::loadProcMap
methods.description: Loads all current processes into a process map from /proc directory.
